scientific_purpose: Controlled decision-scale ablation: same 100-epoch models, folds, seeds and train-only threshold selection as the completed original-policy validation. Transform each held-out full-pool score to its within-pool percentile, transfer each inner-selected threshold as an inner full-pool percentile, then average percentile margins. Test scale transfer without changing ranking learners or prescribing a call count.
selection_rule: One prespecified rank-margin ablation after observing scale instability. Report all original policies and paired comparisons. No blind payload generation, hidden-label inference or selecting a policy by post-hoc maxima.
limitations: Each outer evaluation excludes all test-group measurements before five-model construction and threshold fitting. Effective model training size is 64 percent of development versus 80 percent for blind deployment; same relative algorithm, smaller evaluation sample. Historical cached whole-ensemble scores are used only for matching retrospective rank-rate diagnostics, never to select nested thresholds. Resampled conditional intervals omit training and protocol-selection uncertainty.
